name: Photosynthesis Process Diagram
description:
Create a 3-page science flipchart explaining photosynthesis.

Your task:
1. Page 1 (Introduction): Title 'Photosynthesis' and a definition mentioning it is the process by which plants make their own food.
2. Page 2 (The Process): Create a visual diagram. Draw a YELLOW SUN (circle/ellipse) and a PLANT (green rectangle or drawing). Add arrows pointing TO the plant labeled 'Sunlight', 'Water', and 'Carbon Dioxide'. Add arrows pointing AWAY from the plant labeled 'Oxygen' and 'Glucose'.
3. Page 3 (Equation): Type the chemical word equation: 'Carbon Dioxide + Water + Sunlight -> Glucose + Oxygen'.

Save the file to '/home/ga/Documents/Flipcharts/photosynthesis_lesson.flipchart'.
